definitions.explanation: Very light rain with extremely fine droplets, similar to mist.

examples.japanese: {霧雨|きりさめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っている→降る：00839_furu⟧。
{霧雨|きりさめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっとり→しっとり：05837_shittori⟧⟦{濡|ぬ}れた→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧。
examples.english: My clothes got damp from the drizzle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さすほどで⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{霧雨|きりさめ}だった。
examples.english: It was a light drizzle, not enough to need an umbrella.

notes:
{霧雨|きりさめ} is very fine, mist-like rain — lighter than ⟦{小雨|こさめ}→小雨：05861_kosame⟧ (light rain). The droplets are so fine they almost float in the air rather than clearly falling.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧ (mist, fog) + {雨|さめ} (rain) — literally "mist-rain." The reading さめ is a combining form of あめ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {霧雨|きりさめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: drizzle falls
- {霧雨|きりさめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{濡|ぬ}れる→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧: to get wet from drizzle
- {霧雨|きりさめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: drizzle continues

RAIN VOCABULARY (light → heavy):
- {霧雨|きりさめ}: misty drizzle (finest)
- ⟦{小雨|こさめ}→小雨：05861_kosame⟧: light rain
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: rain
- ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧: heavy rain
- ⟦{土砂降|どしゃぶ}り→土砂降り：07680_doshaburi⟧: downpour
- ⟦{豪雨|ごうう}→豪雨：05860_gouu⟧: torrential rain

USAGE:
Often described as rain so light you may not need an ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧ (umbrella), though it still gets you damp over time.
